d:
Tapu’s child bride, Tina, begins living in the Gada household. Between Tina crying over Jethalal’s loud snoring, making unboiled cold tea, and demanding chickoo jam and cheese cubes, Jethalal gets scolded and driven out of his own bedroom to sleep outside
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
